text:
maria-ops: Acme AP pinged us. Invoice OH-2026-0421 shows two platform lines; they want a clearer customer-facing invoice or confirmation before they post.

sam-fin: Can someone confirm whether the negative line is an approved credit or a billing glitch? Totals match the SOW but AP won't accept ambiguous descriptions.

kelly-ar: @maria-ops paste the invoice lines? If AP posts two lines into their GL they'll break the reconciliation. We normally net credits on the face of the invoice.

maria-ops: Paste (redacted):
```
Line 12: PLATFORM_SERVICE - $120,000 - SKU PF-ENT-2025
Line 13: PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ - ($12,000) - SKU PF-LEGACY-CREDIT
Line 14: SUPPORT_TIER_GOLD - $30,000 - SKU SUP-GOLD
Total due: $138,000
```
Acme says "PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ" has no approval reference.

billing-bot: Billing export 2026-04-20-19:03: rule PF-LEGACY-CREDIT emits as separate negative row. Generated ticket BILL-7842.

sam-fin: That $12k matches the consolidation credit approved last year. We need the approval ID and either a corrected invoice or a formal cover note for AP.

kelly-ar: Found AR approval: APPR-2025-1128 by Jordan CS for $12,000 labeled "Platform consolidation credit - Acme Health" (2025-12-18). I will attach the PDF to the account record.

jordan-cs: Confirmed. I can email the approval confirmation to Acme AP and cc billing. 

billing-ops: BILL-7842 assigned to @billing-ops. We can reissue OH-2026-0421 with a single line "Platform Fee (net of migration credit)" and memo "See APPR-2025-1128". ETA 2 business days.

sam-fin: OK. Action: 1) @kelly-ar attach APPR-2025-1128 PDF to the customer record and this ticket, 2) @billing-ops reissue invoice or send a cover letter referencing APPR-2025-1128, 3) I'll update GL posting guidance for this account so AR posts to single platform revenue line.

maria-ops: I'll notify the Acme billing contact so they expect the corrected invoice/cover note and don't escalate. Thanks all. :pray:
